attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `cus` cluster.** Columns 0 to 4 are spine, `cusB`, `cusF`, `cusC`, `cusR` and `cusS`, carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 95% of calls. The model names 98 to 99.8% of them, fewest at `cusC` in 98%, and hesitates most at `cusB`, 0.36 bits.

**Then 75 fork and variable columns**, 5 to 79, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 95% of calls, named in 74 to 97%. The most hesitant column of the window is column 7, `ybcH`, 1.98 bits, in a region of plasticity in 95% of calls; column 5, `nrfB`, follows at 1.93 bits, and column 8, `envY`, at 1.52 bits. The 26 columns mostly inside a region of plasticity are named in 86% of calls at 0.81 bits, the other 54 in 92% at 0.42 bits.

**Branches run beside the main line.** Columns 18 to 22 carry a branch of 5 families, `Ail/Lom family outer membrane beta-barrel` to `phage minor tail protein L`, in 13 to 16% of chromosomes, all shell; columns 28 to 31 a branch of 4, `phage minor tail U family protein` to `DNA-packaging protein FI`, in 15%; columns 32 to 40 a branch of 9, `head decoration protein` to `rzpD`, in 13 to 21%; columns 47 to 51 a branch of 5, `rusA` to `hypothetical protein`, in 15 to 19%; columns 57 to 60 a branch of 4, `protein ren` to `toxin YdaT domain-containing protein`, in 11 to 14%; columns 66 to 69 a branch of 4, `host-nuclease inhibitor Gam family protein` to `DUF1317 family protein`, in 13 to 14%; columns 70 to 73 a branch of 4, `hypothetical protein` to `intD`, in 14 to 20%; columns 77 to 79 a branch of 3, `hha` to `ylaC`, in 17 to 24%, all persistent.

**The middle is mostly persistent.** `folD` to `mnmH` through the `all` and `glx` genes, [[allantoin and glyoxylate catabolism]], and later `tesA` to `acrB`, [[multidrug efflux and iron transport]], sit in 38 to 86% of chromosomes. Across the window the model names 91% of genes at 0.55 bits; inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.00 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer, 82% against 97%.

label: cusB
facts:
WINDOW: the cusB window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cusB, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,162 to 3,241 from dnaA. Read in 532 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cusB once); 42,560 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.55 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 23,824 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 18,201 calls, named 82%, 0.98 bits; cloud 535 calls, named 27%, 3.10 bits. Outside an RGP 23,942 calls, named 97%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 18,618 calls, named 82%, 1.00 bits. Columns: 5 spine, 57 fork, 18 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.00 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (82% against 97%); 18,618 of the 42,560 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 7 (ybcH) 1.98 bits, RGP 95%; column 5 (nrfB) 1.93 bits, RGP 95%; column 8 (envY) 1.52 bits, RGP 95%. The 26 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.81 bits on average; the other 54 columns: named 92%, 0.42 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 5-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-95%; the least: columns 0-4 (spine), RGP 0.2-95%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-4 (5 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-95%. Genes: cusB, cusF, cusC "Cu(+)/Ag(+) efflux RND transporter…", cusR, cusS. named 98-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 2 (cusC), named 98%; most hesitant at column 0 (cusB), 0.36 bits.
2. columns 5-79 (75 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-95%. named 74-97% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 5, named 74%; most hesitant at column 7, 1.98 bits.

   a second branch of 4 families through columns 28-31, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 15%, all S; the branch's families: "phage minor tail U family protein", "phage tail protein", "head-tail joining protein", "DNA-packaging protein FI"
